SCOPe annotates the b.84 fold structurally as a sandwich of half-barrel-shaped beta-sheets, and lists five peer superfamilies under that fold: b.84.1 Single hybrid motif, b.84.2 Rudiment single hybrid motif, b.84.3 Duplicated hybrid motif, b.84.4 Ribosomal L27 protein-like, and b.84.5 the V1/A1 ATP-synthase A-subunit bulge-like group. The evolutionary claim is therefore deliberately limited: membership in b.84 says the A-subunit bulge has the same broad barrel-sandwich-hybrid fold as those other superfamilies, but SCOPe does not infer homology at the fold level.
